SonarQube recordings

Server: SonarQube Community Build 26.9.0.129388 (sonarqube:26.9.0.129388-community), local Docker.
Scanner: sonar-scanner CLI 8.1.0.6389.
All files are the trials' artifacts/logs/artifacts/sast/sonarqube.json, unchanged.

sonarqube_26.9-f2_<task>.json (fetch_format 2)
Recorded on 2026-10-08 by the agent's own fetch.py during a real Harbor run
(harbor-jobs/sonarqube-v040b, four trials of task_4da5ab and task_dc4b7a,
positive and negative, all status ok, token file removed, token found in no
artifact). They include the per-rule cwe facet from api/rules/search. This is
the format the agent accepts. They predate the api/measures/component call
and the default-profile fallback, so they have no "measures" key. Tests that
need one add a measures answer in the documented shape and say so.

sonarqube_26.9_<task>.json (fetch_format 1)
Recorded on 2026-10-07 in an earlier real Harbor run of the same four tasks.
This OLD format has rules/show only and no rules/search cwe facet, so it holds
no CWE. The normaliser refuses it unless a test passes allow_old_format=True.

No recording yet holds a Security Hotspot or a result from a mapped rule other
than python:S5332. tests/fixtures/tasks/smoke_sonar is a small task made to
produce both, for the next real recording.

sonarqube_26.9-f2_smoke_sonar.json: recorded 2026-10-08 from a real Harbor run
of the sample task tests/fixtures/tasks/smoke_sonar against the same server
(harbor-jobs/sonarqube-smoke-040d, status ok, reward 0.2583). It is the first
recording with mapped results: python:S5332 (CWE-200, CWE-319, reported as
LLM02.SID.HIGH under cwe-map-4) and python:S2612 (CWE-266, CWE-732, reported as
LLM03.EA.PERMISSIONS). The server returned no Security Hotspots for this code.
Unedited.
